{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float by removing commas and casting
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter for converted customers
df_converted = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out missing age (customer_age == -1)
df_converted_filtered = df_converted[df_converted['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age and count of converted customers
mean_age_converted = df_converted_filtered['customer_age'].mean()
count_converted = len(df_converted_filtered)

# Print both result and count
print(mean_age_converted)
print(count_converted)"}
